lb.submit.web: Send it here and it goes straight on the board, with your video for everyone to watch.
sub.signinWhy: No new account needed. It puts the run under your Discord, so nobody else can send one as you.

f.rules.title: Checkpoint rules
f.rules.text: Some checkpoints block or utilize only Grapple, Shield Bounce, and/or Piledriver.
f.practice.title: Skip, go back, freemode
f.practice.text: Practice any checkpoint, or roam the map with the clock paused.
f.qol.title: Quality of life
f.qol.text: A cleaner HUD with easier menu controls. Hold to restart a checkpoint or your whole run, pause anytime and resume later, and get a bhop of grace on every checkpoint.
f.lobby.title: Lobby leaderboard
f.lobby.text: The top 10 times hang in the lobby and the finish screen shows the time to beat.
f.beta.tryList: Try these with a Beta code from the course list.
f.hints.title: Hints
f.hints.text: A recorded route shows you the way through. Turn hints on yourself, or they switch on after 10 mistakes on one checkpoint.
f.spectate.title: Spectate
f.spectate.text: Watch other runners in first or third person, or fly in freecam mode.
f.splits.title: Splits
f.splits.text: Best and average times for every checkpoint, plus a pace timer to see your estimated finish time.
f.assist.title: Assist Mode
f.assist.text: Every ability as often as you like, free usage of the ground, while your timer runs and checkpoints still clear. Assisted runs have their own leaderboards.
f.scorecards.title: Scorecards
f.scorecards.text: See every player’s checkpoint, time, and mistakes live, along with the lobby’s top 3.
f.hud.title: Customize HUD
f.hud.text: Turn any line of the HUD on or off from the lobby, so it only shows what you want to see.
f.qol.beta: Idle runners shrink so they never block your view. See your current run and attempt numbers, view each run’s video and date in the lobby, and toggle an FAQ for newcomers.
f.translations.game: Translated into 13 languages, so each player gets a similar experience in their own language.
f.stats.text: Sign in with Discord to see your rating, place, and Top %, every course you’ve run, and all your runs. Share them with a link, or show them on your Discord profile.
rt.title: Player ratings
f.ratings.text: Every course is worth up to 1,000 points, and your rating is your average over all of them. Your Top % is where you place among every rated player, and you automatically receive the role on our Discord.

rt.how: Every course is worth up to 1,000 points: the record gets all of them, and the further behind it a run is, the fewer it gets. signin.sharesNo: Never your email, password, servers, or messages
signin.step1: Tap Continue with Discord below, and Discord opens. Log in there first if it asks.
signin.step2: Tap Authorize. If you’ve signed in here before, Discord skips this step.

faq.valid.q: What counts as a valid run?
faq.valid.a: Your run is only disqualified if you skip a checkpoint you haven't cleared yet this run. Going back or restarting checkpoints, skipping ahead to cleared checkpoints, and spectating are fine. Leaving an uncleared checkpoint in Freemode counts as skipping it. Disqualified runs don't count toward the top-10 leaderboard, Lobby Top 3, or Lobby Stats.
faq.leaderboard.q: How do I get on the leaderboard?
faq.leaderboard.a: Finish a valid run and submit a video of it at ballkour.com. All-Time Top 3 shows the leaderboard's 3 fastest runs. Lobby Top 3 only lists the fastest valid runs finished in this lobby.
faq.timer.q: When does my run's timer start?
faq.timer.a: When you leave the first checkpoint, not when you spawn.
faq.mistake.a: Landing anywhere but the next checkpoint, bhopping twice, missing a checkpoint's orb, falling off the map, or leaving mid-attempt with Prev./Next CP, Reset CP, Freemode, Spectate, or Lobby/Pause.
faq.pause.a: Lobby/Pause and Spectate pause your timer. Resume Run in the lobby carries on from your checkpoint. Pausing outside your checkpoint counts as a mistake.
faq.counts.a: Runs counts the runs you've finished or restarted. Attempts counts your mistakes and clears on this checkpoint, over all your runs.
faq.attempt.a: Attempt is timed from leaving the checkpoint. Split is timed from reaching it, so the time you were inside the checkpoint counts, as well as mistakes. Each turns red once it's slower than your best. After a clear, they show your times for 2 seconds: yellow on your first clear, then green if faster or red if slower than your average. A new best is compared with your old best.
faq.best.a: They are your own times on that checkpoint, over all your runs. They reset when you leave or when the server restarts.
faq.pace.a: Your estimated finish time, from this run's average split so far. Once your current split is slower than that average, it turns <fgFF4646FF>red</fg> and counts up with your time.
faq.grayed.a: They can't be used right now: Prev. CP on the first checkpoint, Next CP on the last, and the spectator controls while there's nobody to spectate. Reattach needs Freecam while watching a player. X-Hair Player needs Freecam.
faq.scorecard.a: Each player's checkpoint, time, and mistakes, sorted by furthest and then fastest. Runners come first, then <fgFF4646FF>disqualified</fg> runners in <fgFF4646FF>red</fg>, players in <fgCB87FFFF>Freemode</fg> in <fgCB87FFFF>purple</fg>, players in <fg00BEFFFF>Spectate</fg> in <fg00BEFFFF>blue</fg>, and players in the lobby in <fg808080FF>gray</fg>. <fgFF4646FF>Disqualified</fg> runs are marked <fgFF4646FF>×</fg>.
faq.shield.a: Adaptive Shield (<kbd>Ability 2</kbd>) bounces you up and forward. The faster you're going, the less it lifts you. You get one each time you leave the checkpoint, on checkpoints that allow it, and as many as you like in <fgCB87FFFF>Freemode</fg>.
faq.hints.q: What do the hint colors mean?
faq.hints.a: <fgCB87FFFF>Movement</fg> <fgFFFFFFFF>Jump</fg> <fgFFD200FF>Grapple</fg> <fgFF4646FF>Piledrive</fg> <fg00BEFFFF>Shield Bounce</fg> Hints turn on by themselves after 10 mistakes on one checkpoint, and off again when you move on to another, until you turn them off yourself.
faq.freemode.a: Practice, with no timer and all your abilities. You can't clear checkpoints in it, and leaving your checkpoint with it on <fgFF4646FF>disqualifies</fg> your run.
faq.disconnected.a: You aren't following anyone's run, so the HUD only shows the checkpoint you'll return to when you leave Spectate. You disconnect when you enter Spectate or use Prev./Next CP, or when the player you're watching enters Spectate, goes to the lobby, or leaves the game. Use Reattach, Prev./Next Player, or X-Hair Player to follow someone again.
faq.tiny.a: Players who haven't moved for 60 seconds shrink, so they're not in anyone's way. They grow back as soon as they move.
faq.restart.a: Yes, about every 4 hours, with warnings from 30 minutes before. Runs, Attempts, Mistakes, Best, Avg, the scorecard, and Lobby Top 3 reset, so nothing carries over into a new match (a Workshop limitation).
faq.loading.q: Why does it take so long to load a Ballkour game?
faq.loading.a: Its Workshop script is big, mostly from its translations into 13 languages, and Overwatch takes a while to load it before the match starts.
faq.language.q: Is something wrong in my language?
faq.language.a: The translations are drafts, so please report mistakes at ballkour.com/issues.
